competences.description: Attacks the enemy target 2 times and attacks all enemies with even more powerful attack on the 3rd attack.

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with 3 magic bullets, dealing 30% increased damage if the target has no beneficial effects, and Silences the target for 2 turns with a 75% chance each. The target under the Silence Effect won't be able to use skills with cooldown time excluding the passive skills.

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

competences.description: Increases the damage you deal by 100% if the enemy has more HP than you, and increases your Attack Power by 150% until the next turn if you receive damage from an enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: if the enemy has more HP than you

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
effets.note: if you receive damage from an enemy
